title: Humans rarely set a comment kind; agents should; a small picker the size of the label (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
ok. can we look at the ui on the comment a bit? 
Most of the time, a human won't need to set the kind. But an agent should. Can we make a widget that is a bit more the size of the final label that allows us to select the type.
